name: @xynolog/protocol
description: Cross-implementation contracts, specifications, and conformance suites for Xynolog

scripts.specs:bundle: redocly bundle --config specs/redocly.yaml specs/src/openapi.json -o specs/openapi.json && redocly bundle --config specs/redocly.yaml specs/src/archivist/openapi.json -o specs/archivist.openapi.json
scripts.specs:check: node scripts/checks/specs/check-protocol.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-archivist.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-identifiers.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-jobs.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-offset-units.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-reference-forms.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-reply-bounds.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-registry-form.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-registry-prose.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-tables.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-client-types.mjs && node scripts/checks/specs/check-ownership-inventory.mjs
